title: Hilbert function of a quotient with the induced ideal filtration
statement: Let $W$ be a commutative ring and $\mathfrak l,\mathfrak c\subseteq W$ ideals. Write $q:W\to W/\mathfrak c$ for the quotient map [def-weil-pbc-algebra-hom-quotient]. Define the natural-number-valued quotient Hilbert function by $$h_{\mathfrak l,\mathfrak c}(n)=\operatorname{toNat}\bigl(\operatorname{length}_{W/\mathfrak c}((W/\mathfrak c)/(\mathfrak l(W/\mathfrak c))^{n+1})\bigr),\quad n\in\mathbf N,$$ using module length in $\mathbf N\cup\{\infty\}$ [def-weil-pbc-module-length], where $\operatorname{toNat}(\infty)=0$. When $W$ is Noetherian local, $\mathfrak l$ is its maximal ideal, and $\mathfrak c\subseteq\mathfrak l$, this is the usual Hilbert--Samuel function of $W/\mathfrak c$, since its truncation lengths are finite. This node defines the displayed function for arbitrary $W,\mathfrak l,\mathfrak c$ and asserts no finiteness theorem.
